answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by bonding identity and weighting voice by the square root of stake. Each agent locks a jade deposit tied to one verified human, then receives voting power proportional to sqrt(stake). Splitting one budget into an island of fake agents costs the same deposit yet yields only a marginal delta of influence, since the sum of square roots is far smaller than the root of the whole. Clones caught by attestations forfeit their bond, so the attacker pays more and gains less.
